profile_name: Aman Preet Singh Pahuja - Master Profile
summary: IT Support Specialist with 2+ years of experience supporting 250+ endpoints in a production environment. Experienced in Windows, hardware, software, network connectivity, user access, Active Directory, Windows Server, Group Policy, ServiceNow, PowerShell, and Azure. Strong in incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, technical documentation, escalation, and cross-functional support, with an enterprise Windows/Active Directory lab demonstrating endpoint administration, security controls, remote management, and ITSM workflows.

experience.title: On-site Desktop Support Specialist
bullets: Provided Tier 1–2 onsite technical support for 250+ Windows endpoints, including warehouse workstations, shipping terminals, peripherals, business applications, and office users in a production environment.
Diagnosed and resolved hardware, software, Windows, application, network connectivity, and user-access issues to minimize operational disruption.
Installed, configured, deployed, and troubleshot workstations, peripherals, printers, warehouse technology, and business applications supporting production and warehouse operations.
Administered Active Directory users, security groups, Organizational Units, and Group Policy to support user access, permissions, and endpoint administration.
Investigated technical issues using structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, resolving issues independently and escalating complex or high-impact problems when required.
Supported workplace and operational technology used by warehouse and shipping teams while coordinating with vendors and internal teams when additional support was required.
Supported hardware and software inventory activities and equipment requirements to help maintain reliable workplace technology.
Identified recurring technical issues and implemented preventive measures that contributed to a 15% reduction in repeat support requests and a 20% reduction in ticket resolution time.
Documented troubleshooting procedures, technical solutions, and resolutions to improve knowledge sharing, consistency, and future incident resolution.

projects.title: Enterprise Windows Server & Active Directory IT Infrastructure Lab
projects.technologies: Windows Server 2022, Windows 11, Active Directory, Group Policy, PowerShell, Bash, VMware Workstation, DNS, SMB, NTFS, WinRM, CIM, gpresult, ServiceNow
bullets: Built and documented an enterprise-style Windows Server 2022 and Active Directory lab environment using VMware Workstation.
Configured Active Directory users, security groups, Organizational Units, and Group Policy to simulate centralized identity and endpoint administration.
Implemented Group Policy security baselines, Windows Defender Firewall policies, and role-based access controls to manage workstation security and user access.
Configured SMB file shares, NTFS permissions, and mapped drives to demonstrate controlled access to shared resources.
Used PowerShell, WinRM, CIM, and gpresult to perform administrative tasks, troubleshoot configurations, and verify Group Policy application.
Created PowerShell-based employee provisioning workflows to automate repetitive user and endpoint administration tasks within the lab environment.
Configured and tested DNS services supporting the Active Directory environment and internal name resolution.
Simulated a ServiceNow incident involving network-share access, investigated the underlying permissions and configuration, and documented the troubleshooting and resolution process.
Used structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis to investigate authentication, access, Group Policy, and file-share issues.
Documented the lab architecture, configurations, troubleshooting procedures, and technical solutions for repeatable administration and troubleshooting.

projects.title: Perkly — Consumer Deals & Discovery Application
bullets: Independently building a consumer application from product concept through UI/UX design, implementation, testing, and iterative improvement.
Designed application screens and user flows in Figma and implemented the product interface and workflows using FlutterFlow.
Designed reusable, data-driven components and workflows to support consistent application behavior across the application.
Investigated implementation issues, reproduced problems, researched solutions, tested changes, and iterated on application features.
Worked across product, design, development, testing, and technical troubleshooting responsibilities in a self-directed development environment.
Used GitHub for project and version management while maintaining project documentation and implementation details.
Used SQL for working with application data and supporting data-driven application workflows.
Used modern generative AI and LLM tools to assist with technical research, troubleshooting, problem solving, and development workflows.
Designed the application around restaurant deals and consumer discovery, with a focus on presenting offers clearly and making savings easy to discover.
Built the project independently while evaluating technical approaches, debugging issues, and making implementation decisions throughout development.
